Zero waste 
Microsoft is committed to become 
a zero waste company by 2030. 
We are taking an increasingly circular 
approach to materials management 
to reduce waste and carbon emissions. 
Our approach includes design and 
material selection, responsibly 
sourcing materials for our operations, 
products, and packaging, and 
increasing the use of recycled content. 
We keep products and materials in 
use longer through reuse, repair, 
and recycling programs.
